mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.file: Script filename relative to the appliedscripts workspace (for example, "probe1.js"). Its contents are executed as the script. Prefer this to inline code for long scripts, such as batches with baked recipe globals.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.code: Factory script (Rhino ES6), supplied inline or through file. It has the same API as a controller program.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.timeou: Maximum ticks to wait for all go() generators. 0 = evaluate only (generators do not start); -1 or omitted = wait until completion (hard ceiling: one hour). 20 ticks = one second.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.execute.tool: Runs a probe program against the bound controller and returns its logs. Pass code inline, or put it in the appliedscripts workspace and pass file.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.upload.file: Program filename relative to the appliedscripts workspace (for example, "production.js"). Its contents are uploaded. Prefer this to inline source for long programs with baked recipe globals.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.upload.source: Complete controller program, supplied inline or through file. It is compiled before replacement; if compilation fails, the live program remains unchanged. This matches saving in the controller editor.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.upload.tool: Replaces the bound controller's production program. Prefer validating it with appliedfactory_execute before upload.
mcp.appliedfactory.prompt.status.tool: Read-only status of the MCP connection and bound controller.
